description: The decision-making layer underneath every asset class — advisor self-awareness (not just client bias), structural tools that manage client behavior better than reassurance, framing effects, mental accounting, and the peer-reviewed foundations (Kahneman & Tversky, De Bondt & Thaler) that are still producing new findings. Distinct from behavioral.brain_map (neuroscience of 4 brain regions).
name: behavioral.deep_dive_track
title: Behavioral Economics Deep Dive Track
